title: Foreman-C Worker Pool
description: Foreman-C coordinates workers 041-060 as one aggregated pool. The room shows pool summaries plus only important worker exceptions.

messages.text: Workers 041-060 take alternating lanes. The pool pauses dependent rows until Gate A and Gate B are green.

messages.systemLog: Tools Call: channel.open: Foreman-C assigns Packet C to workers 041-060.

messages.text: worker-052 found a one-block offset in row 02. I am isolating seven placements as a patch and keeping the other lanes moving.
Patch applied to row 02. Pool C has learned Replace: verify the wrong block, remove it safely, place the corrected block, then write one audit record. Publishing this SKILL to the shared library.

messages.systemLog: Skill Scheduler: Replace is committed to the Shared Skill Library from Foreman-C row-02 patch and shared to every Foreman worker pool.

messages.text: Pool C complete. Workers placed all assigned lanes, skipped high-risk corners for review, and reported zero rollbacks.

messages.systemLog: Tools Call: channel.close: Pool C completes Packet C and submits its diff shard.
